g.text: Same Haiku Main · 8 short-history tasks · full history versus a Haiku-generated summary
History: 175–2,209 characters, comfortably within context. This tests overhead and retention, not long-session context pressure.
All 8 decisions declined command selection; overhead reused.
HOSTED SUPPORT FOLLOW-UP — SAME 8 TASKS, MAIN FIXED TO HAIKU, JEV OFF
Short-history result: no accuracy gain from summarizing. A ready summary reduced measured answer time; waiting for one added work.
¹ Single-run replay timings, not a significance test. Earlier direct controls are reused; sampling/cache/load can differ. No game, speech or native session effects.
² Cost extrapolates these 8 trials to 1,000; Haiku uses uncached token list estimates. Jev uses reported charges. Ready/blocking rows reuse the same answers.
Stock summaries are conditional/background, not one extra call on every turn. Hosted calls consumed the existing Free-plan allowance; charge/quota totals were not exposed.
Models: Claude Haiku 5.5 compatible defaults; hosted GLM 5.3 Flash and Haiku 5.5; local Qwen3.5-4B Q4_K-M. Local API fee excludes hardware/electricity.
Local hardware: RTX 2080 Ti 11 GiB · i7-10700K · 32 GiB RAM · llama.cpp b10964. Saved settings unchanged. AI-reviewed synthetic references. 2026-11-09.
